hero.headline: Freight that keeps its promises
hero.sub: Ocean, air and road freight for shippers who need a partner that answers the phone at 2am. From Kampala to over 120 countries, we move cargo — and we own every mile of the paperwork.

services.name: Ocean Freight
services.desc: FCL and LCL container shipping across every major trade lane, with consolidation out of Mombasa and Dar es Salaam.

services.name: Air Freight
services.desc: Time-critical cargo on scheduled and charter flights, with priority handling for perishables and pharma.

services.name: Road & Rail
services.desc: Cross-border trucking across the East African Community, plus rail links to inland container depots.

services.name: Warehousing & Distribution
services.desc: Bonded and general warehousing with pick-pack-ship fulfilment for regional distribution.

services.name: Customs Brokerage
services.desc: Licensed clearing agents handling documentation, duty calculation and compliance at every border post.

services.name: Project & Heavy-Lift Cargo
services.desc: Engineering, route surveys and permits for oversized, high-value and industrial cargo movements.

services.name: Airport Clearance & Handling
services.desc: Expedited customs clearance at major African airports with bonded warehouse storage and same-day delivery coordination.

services.name: Freight Forwarding
services.desc: Door-to-door freight forwarding with multi-modal routing, real-time tracking and complete documentation management.

services.name: Large Container Shipping
services.desc: Dedicated 20ft and 40ft container services with full load optimization, stacking permits and port-to-port logistics.

about.headline: Built by people who've stood at the border post at 4am
about.story: Trance Logistics started with a single truck route between Kampala and Mombasa, run by a team that had spent years watching cargo get stuck — not because of distance, but because of paperwork, delays and middlemen. Today we operate across nine major service lines, from airport clearance to large container shipping, with offices in six countries.
about.mission: To move cargo for East African businesses with the reliability of a global carrier and the responsiveness of a local partner.
